payload.title: Expose the fencing token on complete/release/update in the CLI
payload.body: The backend supports claimId fencing but the CLI complete/release/update commands do not accept --claim, so a CLI user cannot pass the fencing token and complete runs unfenced. Add --claim to those commands so a resurrected stale owner cannot clobber a new owner via the CLI, matching what the conformance suite proves programmatically.
